newsitem.title: INDIA: Hewlett sees strong revenue growth in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett sees strong revenue growth in Asia.

text.p: U.S. computer maker Hewlett-Packard Co (HP) expects revenue from personal computer (PC) sales in the Asia-Pacific region to grow an average of 35 percent a year over the next three years, a senior company official said on Thursday.

Adrian Rene Koch, general manager for computer product sales in the region, told a news conference in the Indian capital that revenue was expected to grow from $1.8 billion in the 1996 financial year ending next month to $4.4 billion in the 1999 financial year.
He said HP had identified India, China and Indonesia as major markets for big investments, and was setting up infrastructure, sales support and other facilities in the nations to tap their markets.
Koch said HP saw significant market potential in small and medium-sized companies and was tailoring its business strategy to suit this segment, distinct from its traditional big customers.
